name: Battle text
description: The battle's message box no longer stops the fight. Skip (default): no message boxes at all. Async: the action goes on while the formatted text is pushed to the HUD notice queue, dropping notes the animation already shows (a plain Attack, Evade, stance and gauge notes). Off: the game's own message boxes. Damage, results and the rules are unchanged; the victory and defeat texts stay as they are.

options.name: Mode
options.description: Off: the game's own message boxes. Skip: none. Async: shown in the HUD notice queue without waiting.
